sources.snippet: We’re on a journey to advance and democratize artificial intelligence through open source and open science.

sources.title: Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B · Models - modelscope.ai
sources.snippet: This repository hosts our T2V-1.3B model, a versatile solution for video generation that is compatible with nearly all consumer-grade GPUs. In this way, we hope that Wan2.1 can serve as an easy-to-use tool for more creative teams in video creation, providing a high-quality foundational model for academic teams with limited computing resources.
